## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and outcome. Link relevant existing issues, if any.

## Scope and dependencies

Record relevant prerequisites and owner decisions. Explain any independently useful work deferred beyond this outcome.

## Validation

Map acceptance criteria to exact commands and actual outcomes. Include negative controls, any unavailable check, and any explicitly authorized local provider run. Ordinary CI must not make provider calls.

## Integrity and documentation

- [ ] Global Definition of Done in CONTRIBUTING.md satisfied.
- [ ] Changed contracts have the required identities and documentation; no unrelated revision bumps.
- [ ] No credentials/private code, hidden-test exposure, or verifier network access.
- [ ] Raw evidence remains immutable; failure classes and facets remain distinct.
- [ ] No unrelated changes; the authorized outcome is complete.
